summary:
FIREWISE is a Microgravity Combustion Intelligence Dashboard developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. The project aims to make complex combustion research easier to explore and understand, particularly in the context of spacecraft fire safety.

The dashboard features four NASA investigations: BASS-II, FLEX, SAFFIRE and SAME. It allows users to search and filter investigations, explore research summaries, view illustrative relevance rankings and access NASA research sources.

FIREWISE also explains how combustion behaves differently in micro gravity, where reduced buoyancy-driven movement influences flame behaviour and combustion processes.

By organising scientific information into an interactive and accessible platform, FIREWISE aims to improve awareness of micro gravity combustion research and its relevance to spacecraft fire safety.
details:
FIREWISE is an interactive Microgravity Combustion Intelligence Dashboard designed to make NASA combustion research easier to explore and understand.

The platform features an investigation explorer covering BASS-II, FLEX, SAFFIRE and SAME. Users can search and filter investigations, explore research summaries, compare research themes and view their relevance to spacecraft fire safety.

FIREWISE also explains how microgravity affects combustion and why understanding flame behaviour, material flammability and smoke detection is important for spacecraft safety.

The project aims to make complex combustion research more accessible through an organized, user-friendly dashboard.
